credits.title: Edo²
credits.overview: With another summer drawing to a close in a province of Northern Italy, Edoardo fights to regain control of a youth that feels far too small for him. When an online site appears to truly get him, offering a way to fill his emptiness, Edo seizes the chance to break free from the suffocating fear of never being enough.

credits.title: Il mio nome è Carlo
credits.overview: The movie traces three key moments: the six-year-old boy, already driven by an extraordinary spiritual sensitivity; the eleven-year-old boy, curious and brilliant; and the fifteen-year-old in his first year of high school, self-aware and determined, capable of approaching everyday life with an extraordinary outlook.
